evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Interactive models increasingly hand complex reasoning and tool use to a slow brain in the background, leaving a realtime front model free to sustain full-duplex dialogue.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: With the front model and back end held fixed, replacing Qwen Audio Agent with Jarvis raises tau-Voice task success more than sixfold, from 29 to 192 of 278 tasks, and the gains hold on every benchmark and front model.
